comparison.objective: Calibrate two wrist cameras by acquiring diverse ChArUco-board views and return both arms.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-view arm positioning, visibility/occlusion management, and precise stationary sampling; no task-object transport.
comparison.success_condition: Each camera obtains ≥12 diverse valid samples and meets calibration error limits; board unmoved, arms home for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests perception-calibration trajectory coverage, not dexterous material handling.
